# Yantra4D Full LLM Context

Generated: 2026-05-13

## Purpose

This file gives LLM agents a stable, tool-agnostic map for working in this
repository without depending on vendor-specific instruction files.

## Canonical instruction order

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `README.md` if present
3. `ECOSYSTEM.md` if present
4. Relevant files under `docs/`, `infra/`, `.github/workflows/`, and source
   directories for the specific task

## Agent compatibility

`AGENTS.md` is the source of truth. `CLAUDE.md` exists only to redirect Claude
and other legacy agent integrations to `AGENTS.md`.

## Enclii-first operations contract

Use Enclii web, API, or CLI for routine production provisioning, deployment,
observability, domain management, secrets, provider operations, scaling,
rollback, and remediation.

Raw `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs/APIs, `docker exec`, and direct
container access are allowed only for platform bootstrap or documented
break-glass emergencies when Enclii is unavailable or lacks an implemented
adapter. Any break-glass use must record the actor, reason, target
service/environment, commands executed, result, and follow-up Enclii adapter
gap or incident link.

## Repo entrypoints detected

- `README.md`
- `ECOSYSTEM.md`
- `docs/`
- `infra/`
- `.github/workflows/`

## Maintenance

These files are maintained by `internal-devops/scripts/sync-agent-docs.py`.
If repo-specific long-form agent guidance is needed, put it in `AGENTS.md`,
not `CLAUDE.md`.

## Render release integrity

[Cache identity and artifact storage](docs/operations/render-artifact-storage.md#cache-identity-across-releases) documents API/worker and Studio build namespaces, manifest revalidation and the limits of project-load invalidation. [README](README.md) is the platform overview. Keep runtime revision metadata separate from authored commons manifests.

Shared configuration links preserve Unicode text through JSON escapes and retain legacy decoding. See the [share-link contract and limits](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md#shareable-urls).

Viewer artifact loading has independent completion and lifecycle guarantees. See [blank-viewer diagnostics and shared STL task ownership](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md#blank-viewer--no-stl); render completion alone does not prove canvas delivery.

## Native render output

[Native renderer output and cancellation](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md#native-renderer-stalls-after-substantial-output) explains pipe draining, per-request process ownership, deadlines and remaining isolation limits.

[Mode-specific controls](docs/guides/troubleshooting.md#controls-that-do-not-affect-the-selected-mode) documents the commons-owned visibility contract and actual-pin fastener regression.

## Publication source acceptance

[Viewer resource ownership](docs/architecture/viewer-resource-ownership.md) documents the 32 MiB/16-entry CPU cache, per-consumer geometry, GLTF and animated-grid cleanup, and the limits of these budgets.

[Publication source acceptance](docs/operations/release-source-gate.md) describes the exact-main CI gate, stale-source pin refusal and runtime verification boundary.

Native select validation preserves declared option types, including numeric HTML-select values; undeclared/ambiguous choices are dropped. See docs/guides/troubleshooting.md for the kernel and checkbox encoding contract.
